title: agentgateway edge
description: Installs the upstream agentgateway controller and renders the platform GatewayClass + Gateway.

gatewayClassName.title: GatewayClass name
gatewayClassName.description: Name of the GatewayClass this edge creates; also written to the agentgateway: passthrough (they must match).

controllerName.title: Controller name
controllerName.description: Written to GatewayClass.spec.controllerName AND the controller's AGW_CONTROLLER_NAME; the two must be equal.

name.title: Gateway name
name.description: Must match the installer's exposure.gatewayRef.name and cert-manager-issuers' acme.gatewayRef.name.

listeners.title: Gateway listeners
listeners.description: Passed through verbatim to the Gateway spec.listeners (Gateway API v1). At least an HTTP :80 listener is needed for ACME HTTP-01 and HTTPRoute attachment.

addresses.title: Pinned addresses
addresses.description: Optional. Pin the Gateway to pre-reserved address(es) instead of letting the cloud assign an ephemeral one. Leave unset for ephemeral. A reserved address survives a cluster rebuild; an ephemeral one does not, and published DNS records then point at nothing.

value.title: Address
value.description: The reserved IP or hostname, e.g. 34.154.210.215.

agentgateway.title: Upstream chart values
agentgateway.description: Passthrough to the upstream agentgateway controller chart; set by this blueprint's values.yaml (keep controllerName/gatewayClassName in sync with the top-level).

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected when this chart is used as a subchart).

agentgateway-crds.title: Upstream CRDs chart values
agentgateway-crds.description: Passthrough to the upstream agentgateway-crds chart. Declared because Helm coalesces a values key named after every subchart, and this schema is additionalProperties:false. Not intended for direct use.
